migrationFlags.message: This spec contains no runtime assertion; the migrated check verifies nothing. Authoring a meaningful assertion is an intent judgment left to the developer (the tool never auto-invents one).

Datadog declared 3 browser device profiles (chrome.laptop_large, firefox.laptop_large, edge.laptop_large); deduplicated to 2 distinct Playwright engine project(s) (chromium, firefox). Edge is Chromium-based and runs under the chromium project.

nextSteps: Create 1 private location(s) in Checkly with the slugs shown in the report
Review 2 migration flag(s) in the "Migration Flags" report section (grep "// MIGRATION-FLAG:" in generated specs), then remove the "reviewMigrationFlag" tag and re-activate any deactivated checks

Verify 1 check(s) tagged "reviewMultiSelector" in the "Self-Healing Locator Chains" report section (grep "MIGRATION-LOCATOR-EXHAUSTION" in run logs when a chain misses), then remove the tag once the resolved element is confirmed
Review checks tagged "datadogBasicAuthWeb" — these used web/form-based auth in Datadog and may need converting to browser or multi-step checks
Run "cd ./checkly-migrated/golden && npm run create-variables" to import variables to Checkly
Run "cd ./checkly-migrated/golden && npm run test:public" to validate public checks
Run "cd ./checkly-migrated/golden && npm run test:private" to validate private checks (after creating private locations)
Run "cd ./checkly-migrated/golden && npm run deploy:public" to deploy public checks
Run "cd ./checkly-migrated/golden && npm run deploy:private" to deploy private checks
